description: Settings for the virus and file-type check applied to uploaded files.

fields.label: Virus Scanner
fields.description: The ClamAV virus scanner that each screened file is sent to.

fields.label: Scanner Host
fields.description: The address of the ClamAV virus scanner. Leave it blank to use the host named clamav, the default.

fields.label: Scan Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Seconds to wait for a scan before the scanner counts as down. Uploads wait this long. Blank uses 30.

fields.label: Scanner Port
fields.description: The network port the virus scanner listens on. Leave it blank to use port 3310, the default port.

fields.label: If Scanner Is Down
fields.description: What to do when the scanner is down. Block refuses the file and Allow keeps it. Blank means Block.

fields.label: Active Channels
fields.description: Screening runs only for channels listed here. Tick Rename Mismatched Files to let a row fix a wrong name.

fields.label: Blocking Verdicts
fields.description: An outage of the scanner follows If Scanner Is Down above.

fields.label: Blocking Verdicts
fields.description: The verdicts that refuse a file. One left out is still logged but lets the file through. Blank blocks all.

fields.label: Allowed Renames
fields.description: Used only by a channel row that ticks Rename Mismatched Files.

fields.label: Allowed Renames
fields.description: Each row lets one wrong extension change to the real one. Both must be in System Settings' allowed list.

fields.label: Keep Scan Log (Days)
fields.description: Days a row stays in the File Scan Log before Log Settings deletes it. Leave it blank to keep 90 days.

name: CRM File Screening Settings
